scope: Migration of 109 portfolio client contracts to the existing JUnit/Maven-Failsafe/Selenium owner. Real production Thymeleaf templates and feature scripts run against local HTTP fixtures. This evidence covers selected local browser cases, not a full test-local build, CI/container run, or the three separate real-backend PortfolioUiAcceptanceIT cases.
retainedCoverage: Root, /taxonomy and /teams/blue/taxonomy mount paths; exact-prefix rejection; context-aware links, downloads, import Location redirects and job polling.
Actual backend string[] branch DTOs, including slash-containing branch names; independent defaults and edits for all four branch selectors.
Exact draft whitespace and intentional empty values through deferred reads, active-branch changes, retries and mutation rejection.
Successful mutations remain successful while the follow-up state read is delayed or fails; distinct status/error surfaces and focus are asserted.
Requirement version provenance and incomplete baselines; matrix explicit zero, absent and unknown semantics, provenance, filters and exports.

The routing/recovery hashes are later observations only; both source files have 07:19 UTC write times and identical hashes in post_run4, pre_run5 and pre_run6. No edits to those files occurred after their readiness fixes and during the passing run3.

failedAttempts.correction: Use the resolved Mockito core jar as the ordinary JVM premain agent through JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS; preserve normal JaCoCo argLine, POM and gates.

failedAttempts.correction: Use a 1440x1000 desktop viewport, instant scroll, actual element hit-testing and native clicks; await the actual Bootstrap target pane and loaded page contents.

failedAttempts.correction: Check Bootstrap class tokens independently of ordering and await completion of the offcanvas showing transition. Keep original coverage/source assertions and getText semantics.

failedAttempts.finding: Reproduced exactly: relation=related but activeFilters=none and all four columns retained; only untrusted change/mouseup/click, with no input event.
failedAttempts.correction: Use genuine keyboard selection and assert a newly emitted trusted input event for each selected value. Keep all domain assertions.

driverDiagnostic.optionClickObservation: ChromeDriver Select.selectByValue changed the selected DOM value but emitted only untrusted change/mouseup/click and no input. The production filter listens for input, so the rendered state correctly did not react to that synthetic driver path.
driverDiagnostic.keyboardObservation: HOME/ARROW_DOWN/ENTER/TAB emitted input and change with isTrusted=true. Input/change occurred at ARROW_DOWN, before ENTER; TAB leaves the native picker for subsequent controls. The production page showed Related and exactly REQ-ZERO, REQ-POSITIVE and REQ-UNKNOWN.
driverDiagnostic.pointerControlObservation: W3C Actions opened the native picker with trusted pointer events. An Actions click at the screenshot-observed Related option coordinates (1050,357) dismissed the popup without a value change or selection events. The identical result occurred on a plain HTML select with no production feature scripts. Keyboard selection worked on both pages.
driverDiagnostic.limit: Mouse-only selection through this runtime native-popup routing path remains unverified. The isolated control reproduces the limitation, so this was not classified as an application input-binding defect. No synthetic dispatch or production event-binding change was used to make the contract pass.
driverDiagnostic.temporaryProbeSourceTiming: Current source includes the isolated-control mode added after the first production-page probe; the production-page branch is unchanged. This is a later source observation for that first probe.
driverDiagnostic.probeUses: Existing compiled PortfolioClientTestPage and BrowserSession on the resolved run5 Java test classpath; a temporary Java diagnostic outside the repository, not a new canonical test runner.
